question: What rejuvenating transformation occurs after six months of repeated practice, even for the aged?
premises: The practice is performed for six months.
It is done through repeated application.
Even an old person becomes youthful.
inference: After six months of repeated practice, even an old person becomes youthful.
uncertainties: taruṇā āyate may be read as becoming youthful or attaining youthfulness
plain_english: Through six months of repeated practice, even an old person becomes youthful.
